verdicts.explanation: The introduction states that Li2NH is a good ionic conductor at 3×10−4 S/cm at 25°C, citing ref. 2 (Boukamp and Huggins), so the value, unit, temperature and literature_cited origin are all correct. The 0.58 eV activation energy is stated in Sec. V A for Li2NH with the same ref. 2 citation, and the synthesis, sintering and density fields are correctly null.
